title: La Mora - closing refrain, both piano staves
source_location: York University John Arpin collection JAC009399, printed and PDF p. 5, systems 5–6.
scope: Eight consecutive written bars from the double bar to the end of the print. The lyric-bearing upper piano staff and lower piano staff share the same clock.
editorial: The C4 at the end of each odd bar in bars 1–5 ties to the first C4 in the next bar. The next C4 within bars 2 and 6 is a separate attack.
The score's one-flat key signature applies to the lower-neighbor Bb3 and the lower-staff Bb2.
Phrasing slurs and dynamic hairpins are recorded as printed context. The MIDI uses fixed velocity and an editorial quarter-note tempo of 96.
The last bar keeps both printed sharps in the bass and ends at the double bar. No resolving chord or reprise is added.
